purpose: Teach: 公用/専売/敬称/埋め立て/買い取り/廉価/覚書/即日

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、公用論文と私用論文を分けて管理しろ
lines.en: Ren, keep official and personal research papers organized separately.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Light weight on Ren's name — checking he's tracking. No-nonsense but not unkind. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。特許の専売的権利を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the exclusive patent rights.
lines.style: Attentive, almost formal. Slight pause after the affirmation — showing he's understood the seriousness. Careful pronunciation. The voice of someone who's taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、引用論文の著者敬称に注意しろ
lines.en: Ren, be careful with the honorifics when you cite author names.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not reprimand. Lean in slightly on the caution. Still measured. The tone of someone who's seen this detail matter before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。埋め立て地の生態研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I covered ecological research in reclaimed areas in the paper.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Even pacing. A student reporting back — accurate but not over-eager. Slight dip in energy at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、機材の買い取りリストを更新しろ
lines.en: Ren, update the equipment purchase list.
lines.style: Direct task assignment. Brisk, businesslike. The kind of clarity that expects immediate acknowledgment. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。廉価試薬の代替案を検討しました
lines.en: Yes. I've looked into lower-cost reagent alternatives.
lines.style: Steady, competent report. Light emphasis on the alternatives considered. Professional tone — showing initiative without overstepping. Controlled pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の覚書を作成しろ
lines.en: Ren, draft a memorandum of understanding for the joint research project.
lines.style: Clear instruction, slightly formal. Weight on the task itself. Measured pace. The tone expects understanding and follow-through. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。査読の即日対応は難しい場合がございます
lines.en: Yes. Though same-day turnaround on peer review may not always be possible.
lines.style: Respectful qualification. Slight hesitation before the caveat — carefully honest without being defensive. Soft, apologetic undertone. The voice of someone managing expectations gently.
